contract:
Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::renewBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstances()->any(candidate: User|candidate.UserID = uid),
		copy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstances()->any(candidate: BookCopy|candidate.Barcode = barcode),
		loan: Loan = Loan.allInstances()->any(candidate: Loan|candidate.LoanedUser = user and
		candidate.LoanedCopy = copy and
		candidate.IsReturned = false),
		student: Student = Student.allInstances()->any(candidate: Student|candidate.UserID = uid),
		faculty: Faculty = Faculty.allInstances()->any(candidate: Faculty|candidate.UserID = uid)
	precondition:
		User.allInstances()->exists(candidate: User|candidate.UserID = uid) and
		BookCopy.allInstances()->exists(candidate: BookCopy|candidate.Barcode = barcode) and
		Loan.allInstances()->exists(candidate: Loan|candidate.LoanedUser = user and
		candidate.LoanedCopy = copy and
		candidate.IsReturned = false) and
		user.BorrowStatus = BorrowStatus::NORMAL and
		copy.IsReserved = false and
		loan.DueDate.isAfter(Today) and
		loan.OverDueFee = 0.0 and
		if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then loan.RenewedTimes<3 
		else if user.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) 
		then loan.RenewedTimes<6 
		else false 
		endif  
		endif 
	postcondition:
		loan.RenewedTimes = loan.RenewedTimes@pre+1 and
		loan.RenewDate = Today and
		(if user.oclIsTypeOf(Student) 
		then if student.Programme = Programme::BACHELOR 
		then loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(20) 
		else if student.Programme = Programme::MASTER 
		then loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(40) 
		else loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(60) 
		endif  
		endif  
		else if user.oclIsTypeOf(Faculty) 
		then loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre.After(60) 
		else loan.DueDate = loan.DueDate@pre 
		endif  
		endif ) and
		result = true
}
